comingLast.roast: finished on 18 - even his playing partners are backing the field
still swinging on 18 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
one hot hole and the blue balls change address to Harpley's locker
6 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
the maths says 1 in 5 - the golf so far says get comfortable
a 2-point cushion over Harpley - thin ice, heavy walker
finished 6 clear of the blue balls - now buying Harpley drinks out of gratitude
done, 8 clear, and suddenly an expert on everyone else's back nine
in on a 8-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
